main_text.l: parti ex æqvo acceptus, extincta fuisset
traditio, atqve ex [?]בעל פה facta fuisset
illo momento, [?]בכתב nullusqve fuisset
locus argumento Rabbanistæ contra Ka-
raitam. Nihil enim deus ad scripturæ
complementum, post Esdram traditioni
reliquisset. Hæc pro epistolæ modulo
diffuse nimis. Propterea cætera paucis.
Petis qvem Karaitarum librum habe-
am? unicum habeo, qui in legem com-
mentarius est manuscriptus, in folio
non admodum magno, tres digitos aut
circiter crassum: scribebat An.Chr. 1299 liber inscribitur
[?]ספר המבחר autor R. Apharon filius Josephi. Ex eo autore
manifestum est, Karaitas omnem scri-
pturam veteris testamenti, non secus ac
alii Judæi, amplecti. Solicitos admo-
dum esse in explicandis Masorethicis
& Grammaticis criticis, Talmud & Misnam
non admittere ut regulam fidei, ve-
rum utilem sæpe ad Scripturæ illustra-
tionem. Eadem est illis plane cum
aliis Judæis, qvos Rabbanistas vocant controversia de scriptura & traditionibus,

page.notes: The Hebrew words "בעל פה" (line 1) and "בכתב" (line 2) are set in a slightly irregular form in the scan and are marked [?]. The Hebrew book title is read as "ספר המבחר" and is marked [?]; the letters of the final word are not fully clear. The year "1299" is in old-style numerals and is taken as printed. The Hebrew in the second line of the paragraph is printed inline, so the words are transcribed in their place. "traditioni-" / "bus," is joined as "traditionibus," at the line end.
